subject: Unmapped reads in the BAM file outputted from Rsubread

messages.author: 84fdc92960b0146b
messages.subject: Unmapped reads in the BAM file outputted from Rsubread
parts:
Hi there,

When using align function in Rsubread package to align the reads, it appears that the unmapped reads will be printed into the BAM file.

Is this true? If so, any particular reasons for this?

Is there a need to remove those unmapped reads before feeding BAM file into featureCounts in order to do the quantification analysis?

Many thanks,

Tom

messages.author: bce99ba71cd48eea
messages.subject: Re: Unmapped reads in the BAM file outputted from Rsubread
parts:
Including the unmapped reads in the BAM file is a common practice of read aligners. It preserves all the information in the fastq file input, and one can restore the fastq file from the BAM file when needed. It also helps tools that assemble the mapped and unmapped reads together to build long contigs.

I'm not sure why you hope to remove the unmapped reads from the BAM file before running featureCounts on it. Inclusion of unmapped reads will not affect the counting results.
